summary: Mandatory operating license for public cinema theatres, multiplexes, and open-air movie projection venues.

steps.title: Obtain multi-department NOCs
steps.description: Acquire clearances from Electrical Inspector, PWD Structural, Fire Safety Department, and Municipal Health.

steps.title: Submit Form B application
steps.description: Apply to District Magistrate submitting cinema hall layout, seating capacity, exit pathways, and air-conditioning plans.

steps.title: Joint multi-agency inspection
steps.description: Magisterial committee inspects auditorium acoustics, fire suppression, emergency lighting, and parking facilities.

steps.title: Pay annual license fee
steps.description: Remit state entertainment tax / cinematography license fee at government treasury.

steps.title: Issuance of Form C License
steps.description: District Magistrate issues official operating license specifying approved seating count.
